title: An estimation of economic models with recursive preferences
locator: Eqs.(1)–(2),p44; Table2,p62 (PDF page25/46 including cover); pp56–58,64–65
source_definition: theta=relative risk aversion; rho=inverse EIS; beta=quarterly recursive discount factor
method: Profile sieve minimum distance, second-step GMM; 100 block-bootstrap draws for reported95%CIs
sample: US1952Q1–2005Q1 quarterly; aggregate nondurables/services versus CEX stockholder consumption-mimicking factor; Treasury bill and six equity portfolios
mapping: gamma_V6=theta conceptually; no annualization. beta_source is not beta_V6.
mismatch: Infinite-horizon continuation-value risk; freely estimated EIS>1, versus V6 two-period terminal consumption and EIS=1. Stockholder measure is fitted, not observed long series. Wide CIs; potentially pseudo-true under misspecification.
recommendation: Add high-risk scenarios17,20,60;17–60 is a cross-specification point-estimate span, not a confidence or recommended central range. Retain low-risk evidence separately.
access_notes: Published PDF text verified. Screenshot and Appendix retrieval failed; no claim to have verified unit-EIS appendix numbers. Fre2020 not verified in this supplement.
